entry.title: rethinking typography
entry.content:
I keep coming back to typography, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Typography shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: on typography
entry.content:
I spent a while getting typography wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Typography shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
